private DadosAbertosService.convertToBigDecimal(Object) invoked by reflection. Converts DB-read numbers digit-for-digit: a Float is converted through its decimal text (Float.toString), never through double (0.365f via double would become 0.36500000953674316). In JS/node:sqlite REAL columns arrive as double; the port must reproduce the Float text semantics where the Java entity column is Float. BigDecimal.equals (scale-sensitive). private DadosAbertosService.convertToBigDecimal(Object) invoked by reflection. Converts DB-read numbers digit-for-digit: a Float is converted through its decimal text (Float.toString), never through double (0.365f via double would become 0.36500000953674316). In JS/node:sqlite REAL columns arrive as double; the port must reproduce the Float text semantics where the Java entity column is Float. BigDecimal.equals (scale-sensitive). Double 0.365d -> BigDecimal.valueOf(double) i.e. Double.toString text "0.365"; Integer/Long -> scale 0; null -> null; non-numeric String -> null (NumberFormatException swallowed).
